note: Budget for daily-problem content added after the size-budget.json baseline (which already held Days 1 to 90). Approved in Stage 3B batch 2: app-code budgets in size-budget.json stay as recorded; problems from firstDay on are measured per 30-day solution chunk (solution chunk file + public problem text found verbatim in the build) and are taken out of the dist/ and offline totals. See scripts/content-size.mjs.
projectNote: Added in Workstream 2 (SQL Path projects), as proposed in Step A: each project (its text file, solution file, dataset file and summaries found verbatim) is measured against projectLimitBytes and taken out of the dist/ and offline totals, like daily problems. App-code budgets in size-budget.json are unchanged.
offlineNote: Added in Workstream 3, Phase 1, as approved: offline, budgeted content (Day 91+ chunks and projects) is counted module by module (each module's complete literal, found exactly once in dist-offline/index.html; summaries where found verbatim). The whole offline build, content included, must stay within offlineTotalLimitBytes. Each career path's content is its own lazy module, capped per path: pathContentLimitBytes (chapters, exercises, quizzes, project summaries) and pathProblemsLimitBytes (daily-problem summaries).
